blocks.raw: <Warn>Do not confuse SPP 203.4 (SDP—a sub-service under Professional Architectural Services) with SPP 209 (Professional Architectural Consulting Services / PACS). SDP includes landscape/hardscape planning under the architect's scope; PACS does not.</Warn>

blocks.raw: <Note>Softscape refers to vegetative elements (planting, turf, ground covers). Hardscape refers to constructed elements (paving, walls, steps, water features, site furniture). Both are included in landscaping works cost for fee calculation.</Note>

blocks.raw: <Tip>Memory aid: Small projects = architect does landscaping layout directly. Large projects = architect must hire RLP Landscape Architect as Specialist Consultant. If client hires own Landscape Architect, that fee is the _client's_ account, not deducted from architect's fee.</Tip>

blocks.raw: <Tip>When a question mentions "landscape architecture services" or "plant selection and horticultural design," read carefully. If the context is site development planning and layout integration with civil works, it is SPP 203.4 SDP. If it is standalone landscape design services, it may fall outside standard SDP scope or require an RLP Specialist Consultant on large projects.</Tip>
